questions.stem: BHARATANATYAM is the classical dance of which state?
questions.explanation: Bharatanatyam — Tamil Nadu, evolved from the Sadir dance of devadasis in temples. Rukmini Devi Arundale popularised it in modern form (1930s). Based on Bharata's Natyashastra.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Classical & folk dances of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Match the CLASSICAL DANCE with its STATE. A. Kathak.  B. Odissi.  C. Kuchipudi.  D. Mohiniyattam. List-II: 1. Uttar Pradesh.  2. Odisha.  3. Andhra Pradesh.  4. Kerala.
questions.explanation: Kathak — UP (Lucknow, Jaipur, Banaras gharanas). Odissi — Odisha, temple-origin dance. Kuchipudi — Andhra Pradesh. Mohiniyattam — Kerala (the 'dance of the enchantress'). Other classicals: Bharatanatyam (TN), Manipuri (Manipur), Kathakali (Kerala), Sattriya (Assam).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Classical & folk dances of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: KATHAKALI is the classical dance of:
questions.explanation: Kathakali — Kerala — dance-drama with elaborate make-up (pacha, katti, thadi colours) and costumes. Stories from Mahabharata and Ramayana. Mohiniyattam is the OTHER classical dance of Kerala (more lyrical, by women).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Classical & folk dances of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Match the FOLK DANCE with its STATE. A. Bhangra.  B. Garba.  C. Lavani.  D. Bihu. List-II: 1. Punjab.  2. Gujarat.  3. Maharashtra.  4. Assam.
questions.explanation: Bhangra — Punjab (harvest dance for Baisakhi). Garba — Gujarat (Navratri). Lavani — Maharashtra (on dholki). Bihu — Assam.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Classical & folk dances of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Match the FOLK DANCE with its STATE. A. Chhau.  B. Ghoomar.  C. Yakshagana.  D. Kalbelia. List-II: 1. Jharkhand / Odisha / WB.  2. Rajasthan (royal).  3. Karnataka.  4. Rajasthan (gypsy/snake-charmers' community).
questions.explanation: Chhau — martial/masked folk dance of Jharkhand-Odisha-WB (UNESCO ICH 2010). Ghoomar — Rajasthan royal folk (women). Yakshagana — Karnataka. Kalbelia — Rajasthan, performed by Kalbelia community (UNESCO ICH 2010).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Classical & folk dances of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: SATTRIYA classical dance — added to the classical list in 2000 — is from:
questions.explanation: Sattriya — Assam's classical dance, developed by Vaishnavite saint Sankardev in the 15th century and performed in Sattras (monasteries). Sangeet Natak Akademi recognised it as the 8th classical dance in 2000 (after Manipuri etc.).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Classical & folk dances of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: How many CLASSICAL dances are recognised by the Sangeet Natak Akademi in India?
questions.explanation: Eight classical dances: Bharatanatyam (TN), Kathak (UP), Kathakali (Kerala), Kuchipudi (AP), Odissi (Odisha), Manipuri (Manipur), Mohiniyattam (Kerala), Sattriya (Assam — added 2000). Some also include Chhau as 9th — not universally accepted.
